# Check LiveView initialization after querying an uninitialized view

Current IDL says initialization must be rejected after a database call on an uninitialized view. The inspected InitWithFolder/InitWithTag guard checks mFolderFilter, while GetSQLClause can cache "1" before a filter exists and CountMessages caches the resulting statement. Existing init-failure assertions run after a filter was already set; the uninitialized property test is skipped. Proposed focused test: query an uninitialized view, attempt each initializer, then verify rejection and unchanged results. The static paths suggest an initialization-order gap; no runtime failure was reproduced. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: Panorama initialization static test concern.
